title: RPSC Junior Legal Officer JLO Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Junior Legal Officer posts under RPSC; exam on 26-27 July 2026
qualification: Law degree (LL.B.) as per RPSC JLO notification
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Interview / DV as per RPSC rules
documentsRequired: SSO / application credentials; printed admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open Admit Card for Junior Legal Officer
3. Login and download hall ticket
4. Verify exam centre and shift for 26-27 July 2026
5. Carry printout and original ID on exam day
shortDescription: RPSC JLO Admit Card 2026 released on 23 July 2026 for exam on 26-27 July 2026. Download from rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Junior Legal Officer (JLO) Admit Card 2026 on 23 July 2026.

Examination dates: 26–27 July 2026. Application window was around 27 Aug – 25 Sep 2025.

Download only from rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in and follow exam-day instructions on the admit card.
